text:
maria: quick heads-upwe're doing a small base-image rebuild for sandbox runtimes this Thursday. aim: drop extra pkgs, add seccomp, layered SBOMs, and sign with KMS-backed cosign. need RBAC + audit + runbook updates.

samir: can you enumerate RBAC changes? prefer least-privilege bindings.

maria: build-sa -> kms.cryptoSign on keyRing/infra/sandbox-signer; deployer -> iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator; audit-forwarder-sa -> logging.logWriter. runtime nodes need iam.serviceAccountUser on runtime-sa to pull signed images.

alex: add key rotation/runbook steps in the PR. compromise plan + alternate key pre-created.

elaine: audit-forwarder should include cosign signature metadata and kms.keyVersion fields so SIEM can filter. i'll wire sample events.

security-bot: pre-checklist: 1) key policy review 2) cosign dry-run 3) terraform RBAC PR 4) SBOM diff 5) runbook update.

ops-bot: scheduled canary window Thu 03:00-04:00 UTC for sandbox clusters; notifier -> #eng-oncall.

maria: i'll open three PRs: IAM terraform, pipeline cosign change + test, and runbook/update. tagging reviewers @samir @alex @elaine.

alex: will review IAM PR first. merge required before canary.

maria: summary: minimal base, seccomp added, KMS cosign, RBAC tightened, audit forward validated.
